title: Candidate evals + onboarding sync — week 18
content:
Quick summary: This doc captures the interview debriefs from week 18, an onboarding sync with two recent hires (Sofia & Omar), and team-health notes from the weekly eng check-in. Feel free to add quick reactions inline — we need final hire decisions by Wednesday.

Interview debriefs (short):
- Candidate A (backend infra): strong systems fundamentals, good ownership stories. Score: 8/10. Red flags: limited exposure to GPU infra; but fast learner. Recommend: call with infra lead for practical kernel/ops task before offer.
- Candidate B (ML infra SWE): excellent latency optimization example (reduced 95p by 30%). Score: 9/10. Would slot well on serving-runtime team. Compensation expectation slightly above band; discuss with People.
- Candidate C (staff SWE candidate): mixed signals on cross-team influence, solid technical but weaker on stakeholder management. Score: 6.5/10. Consider bridge role or IC with mentorship plan.

Onboarding sync (new hires):
- Sofia (joined 2024-05-01) — ramping on alerting/observability. Has access to test clusters; paired with Maya for first two sprints. Action: set up shadow pager rotation exposure next week.
- Omar (joined 2024-04-29) — finishing private deploy sandbox tasks. Needs clarity on data access steps (KMS onboarding). Action: Lucas to open ticket to infra for temporary KMS dev key and document step-by-step.

Mentorship / buddy program notes:
- Current buddy load: Maya (3 new hires), Ethan (2). Risk: burnout if more hires added. Proposal: rotate buddy duty monthly and formalize 4-hour shadow onboarding time in calendar.

Team health signals from standup + 1:1s:
- Energy: generally high; shipping cadence OK but two folks noted context switching heavy due to interviews + oncall.
- Burn indicators: increased PR review latency in serving-runtime (avg lag +18%). Potential cause: interview blitz this week + two mid-sprint rollouts.
- Action: defer non-critical code reviews; prioritize rollback checklist for rollout A.

Hiring pipeline and timeline:
- Top priorities: backend infra (req_271), ml infra SWE (req_278). Aim to close offers by 2024-05-15.
- Pending items: compensation calibration with FP&A for candidate B (Maya + People).

Open questions / to-dos:
- Who owns the onboarding checklist updates for private deployments (KMS/HSM steps)? -> Suggested: Lucas.
- Can we formalize a lightweight interview scoring rubric for infra roles? Draft: Priya to circulate v0.1 by Friday.
- Confirm capacity for buddy rotations for next quarter.

Notes to self / loose fragments:
- Follow up with People on offer template that includes expected ramp milestones.
- Add a short bullet list for new hires: "what success looks like in 30/60/90 days" for infra roles.
- Remember to pull interview recordings (with candidate consent) into GH folder for post-mortem examples.

Decisions pending:
- Proceed with verbal offer to Candidate B pending comp alignment.
- Run a final 1-hour working session with Candidate A on a mini infra task before extending offer.

If you have feedback, add inline or ping me in #eng-hiring. I'll consolidate and send final recs to People by EOD Wednesday.
